development.selection_rule: Minimum normalized development MAE across two predefined learning rates; no calibration/test/candidate B predictions used

dataset.hydrogens: All explicit source hydrogens, no embedding or atom addition
dataset.locked_test: Original scaffold-held-out test, IDs and geometry frozen before fitting; labels not used for selection
dataset.generator_overlap_scope: Known SFT training identities only; pretraining corpus overlap unknown

scope: Common-support source 3D prediction. Historical DPA retained separately; common DPA and Uni-Mol share exact splits. Calibration intervals are empirical, not guaranteed conditional probabilities.

protocol.scope: Approximate basis/protocol comparison, not FHI-aims Tier2 equivalence

quantum_protocol_reference.scope: 12 property/size stratified references plus missing B/P diagnostics to cover the frozen cohort; not a random full-OE62 accuracy estimate

records.protocol: PBE0/def2-TZVP/DF(def2-universal-jkfit), grid level3, SCF1e-8; approximate OE62 reference
